_note: I055: note corrections found while writing docs/code/flags-switches-and-inventory-bytes.md. (1) switch_owner_table is zeroed only on a return trip (ClearSwitchOwnersOnReturn), not at every scene load, and its one reader is FacePlayerTowardReturnTarget. (2) Flag $FF (bit 7 of $1A7D) is set at boot and nothing clears it, so the 13 FlagMapPatchTable rows that test it always apply (settles the static part of OQ-I011-13 and OQ-I031-5). (3) The chest array $1A7E starts right behind the 32 event flag bytes; the old wording called it part of the switch array. (4) Flags $0706, $0A00, $0907 and $0601 are bit numbers of FlagMapPatchTable rows, so ApplyFlagMapPatches reads them (settles OQ-I037-4 and OQ-I035-6 for their 'no reader found'). (5) Flag $1B01 is the Green Stone's given flag; the six path markers of gv_up_above_actors_and_name_entry read $1B00-$1B05 (settles OQ-I035-7).
